resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1938 as the build year. The Forest Lookouts site says the Blackstone Valley tower was moved to Buck Hill after a 1937 study, and the Former Fire Lookout Sites entry says that 65-foot steel tower stopped operating at the end of the 1937 season and was first operated in 1926. The most likely reading is that the 1938 date marks erection on Buck Hill, but no source says so directly.

notes_for_editor: Relocation link is from the Forest Lookouts quote of a 1937 annual report and the FFLOS former-sites entry for Blackstone Valley (US 55, RI 2, Durfee Hill, 65-foot steel, operated 1926 to end of 1937 season). Treated as likely, not certain: no source ties the two by serial or identity. The brief record's 1938 'built' is kept as the NHLR date, with the relocation as a resolved conflict rather than a correction. The WWII radio claim comes only from the NHLR description; the story flags it as uncorroborated. Access level 'restricted' is a judgment: the source says 'No public access'. Staffing 'unstaffed' rests on 2016 and 2017 visit reports. Height 19.8 m derives from the NHLR 65 ft figure. Coordinates: brief and NHLR (41.97713, -71.78091) differ slightly from FFLOS (41.97564, -71.77759); the brief's NHLR figures were kept. Elevation: NHLR 730 ft (223 m); brief 222.5 m. Not verified: any change since the July 2017 visit report; whether the Blackstone Valley tower and this tower are the same physical structure.
